paper.title: Multi-Agent Evolve: LLM Self-Improve through Co-evolution
paper.central_claim: A single LLM instantiated as Proposer, Solver and Judge and co-trained by RL with self-judged, difficulty-aware rewards self-improves across math, coding, reasoning and general QA.

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref not exposed to the worker in this runtime; model_type recorded as configured by controller.

evidence.quote: the shared LLM backbone is updated for all three roles simultaneously using the gradients gathered this cycle
evidence.support_explanation: Proposer, Solver and Judge are one backbone updated by RL gradients; the retained product is model weights.

evidence.quote: This design forms a self-rewarding loop where the model can assess and improve itself without external supervision or domain-specific ground truth
evidence.support_explanation: Self-judged reward loop; the judge is also trained (format reward).

evidence.quote: we filter out ‘Unqualified Questions’ whose Quality Score falls below 0.7(on a score scale of [0, 1])
evidence.support_explanation: A judge-filtered question pool (training data) persists; it is not a prompt/skill/tool/workflow/memory/evaluator harness component.

evidence.quote: Experiments on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct demonstrate that MAE achieves an average improvement of 4.54% on multiple benchmarks.
evidence.support_explanation: Author-reported weight-level gain on one 3B model.

signatures.object: Weights of one LLM instantiated as Proposer, Solver and Judge.
signatures.information: Proposer sees generation instructions and optionally a reference question without answer (967 seed questions); Solver sees the question; Judge sees question/answer pairs and scores without ground truth.
signatures.operation: Proposer generates; Judge scores quality (threshold 0.7 admits to pool); Solver answers N times; difficulty reward = 1 - mean judge score; Task-Relative REINFORCE++ updates all roles.
signatures.output: Updated backbone weights; growing pool of admitted questions.
signatures.claimed_effect: Avg +4.54% over base on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct; outperforms AZR and SFT (author_report).
signatures.failure_boundary: Single 3B backbone; judge shares blind spots with generator; no multi-seed.

gap.author_gap: Self-play RL needs grounded verifiers; extend to general domains with self-judged rewards.
gap.lineage: Absolute Zero, SPIRAL, R-Zero, self-rewarding LMs.

tactic_steps_checked: generate/derive training signal from the model's own outputs and filter it: executed (see signatures)
matches.reason: Judge-produced scalar rewards manufactured from the model itself and optimized by RL; secondary C08-style question generation/filter.

pattern_mapping.required_conditions_and_differences: Domain card is a declared boundary pattern (touches weights); the weight-update outcome is excluded by rubric A3, so the mapping is informational only.
